title: Quick Couscous and Chickpea Stew
subtitle: with microwave couscous
description: Soft chickpeas simmered in a rich spiced tomato sauce, served over fluffy couscous made in the microwave.

steps.text: Make the chickpeas: heat oil with the crushed garlic in a pot.
When the garlic is fragrant, add the tomato paste, paprika, harissa, cumin, black pepper and salt. Stir well for about 1 minute until the spices and paste open up.
Add the water and bring to the boil.
Add the chickpeas, reduce the heat and cook for about 40 minutes, until the chickpeas are very soft.
Make the couscous in the microwave: mix the couscous and a little oil in a large bowl. Add the stock powder (optional), salt and boiling water and stir.
Cover the bowl and microwave for 7 minutes.
Remove, take off the cover and stir well. There's no need to add water. Return to the microwave for another 7 minutes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork, or pulse it briefly in a food processor, until light and fluffy.
Serve the couscous with the hot chickpea stew.
